collection.title: Škoda Octavia Hatchback 2019 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Skoda Octavia Hatchback Mk4 2019 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Slim Push Button arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Skoda Octavia.
